profiles.name: A Gentle Feast
profiles.religious_notes: Christian CM curriculum; reviewers cite its biblical integrity; no kindergarten level on Mason's formal-lessons-at-six principle
profiles.price_notes: Living Lesson Plans about $197 per cycle (lifetime access), student packets $50-70, high school bundles about $561, Feast Table membership $31/mo billed annually, books extra; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: ABCmouse
profiles.price_notes: ABCmouse 2.0: free Basic tier (10 activities/day); Premium $14.99/mo or $59.99/yr (promos near $45/yr common), up to 3 child profiles, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Abeka
profiles.religious_notes: Conservative Protestant, young-earth creationist science, providential and patriotic American history throughout
profiles.price_notes: grade 1 child kit about $460, child plus parent kits about $840-1,215; full-grade video with books about $584-1,884 per year by grade and options, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Accelerated Christian Education (ACE)
profiles.religious_notes: Fundamentalist Baptist-rooted; young-earth creationist; content criticized in research and by former students for political and social bias
profiles.price_notes: complete levels (PACEs, score keys, resources) about $224-518 per year; PACEs alone about $118-295, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: All About Reading + All About Spelling
profiles.religious_notes: No religious content; Cathy Duffy files it as secular but Christian friendly, and it is used heavily across both camps
profiles.price_notes: AAR Pre-reading $119.95, AAR Levels 1-4 $159.95 each, AAS levels about $49.95-64.95 each; letter tiles $25.95 one time per household; running both programs is about $210-225 per year, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Alpha Omega (LIFEPAC, Monarch, Ignitia)
profiles.religious_notes: Non-denominational evangelical Christianity integrated across subjects, not just Bible courses
profiles.price_notes: LIFEPAC 5-subject grade sets about $375-552 (K 2-subject set about $156); Monarch online subscriptions about $30-40 per month, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: AmblesideOnline
profiles.religious_notes: Built by Christian mothers with Bible, hymns, and church history scheduled; widely adapted by secular CM families via substitutions, but the default is Christian
profiles.price_notes: curriculum, schedules, and forum are free; families pay only for books (many are public domain online, typical out-of-pocket is used-book money); as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Apologia (Exploring Creation science)
profiles.religious_notes: Explicitly young-earth creationist. The biblical worldview is woven through the science itself, not confined to sidebars; evolution is argued against, not just omitted. Secular reviewers consistently rate it unusable for secular families.
profiles.price_notes: about $94 list per elementary course set (textbook plus notebooking journal), $120-160 for a high school print course with notebook, $319 list per self-paced online course; frequent 25 percent sales; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Beast Academy
profiles.price_notes: books about $100 to $120 per level, Beast Academy Online $99.99 per year first student ($15.99 monthly), online-plus-books bundle $160, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Beautiful Feet Books
profiles.religious_notes: Gently Christian: founders are Christian, some guides include Bible readings, most lessons are faith-neutral; charter-approved pack variants remove religious titles
profiles.price_notes: teacher guides alone about $25-60; complete packs with books $145-290 (Medieval 5-8 pack $289.95), less if borrowing books from the library, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Berean Builders (Dr. Jay Wile science)
profiles.religious_notes: Young-earth creationist, written by the author of the original Apologia high school courses; Wile engages opposing views (old-earth, evolution) in the text rather than ignoring them.
profiles.price_notes: elementary set (hardcover text plus Helps and Hints) about $49 per year; high school Discovering Design book $69 plus $10 answer key, lab kit extra; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Building Foundations of Scientific Understanding (BFSU)
profiles.publisher: Bernard J. Nebel (self-published via Outskirts Press)
profiles.religious_notes: No religious content; Volume III teaches deep time, the fossil record, and evolution directly, which Cathy Duffy flags for Christian users and secular families count as a feature.
profiles.price_notes: about $25-40 per print volume, $9.99 Kindle, about $5 ebook; each volume covers roughly three school years, so the per-year cost is trivial; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: BiblioPlan
profiles.religious_notes: Protestant; leans young-earth in Ancients while airing other Christian views; Cathy Duffy notes a slightly conservative political slant in the Modern course
profiles.price_notes: Lesson Plans Plus $38.95-$42.95, Remember the Days spine $38.95-$49.95, Cool History workbooks by level; a typical family year runs about $110-160 shared across kids, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: BJU Press Homeschool
profiles.religious_notes: Conservative evangelical Protestant, young-earth creationist science, biblical worldview shaping in every subject; slightly more academic and less devotional in tone than Abeka
profiles.price_notes: textbook grade kits about $700-1,500 list; full-grade video kit about $1,149 with books or $979 online only, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Blossom and Root
profiles.religious_notes: Decidedly secular; Cathy Duffy states it is so strongly secular she doubts it will work for families with Judeo-Christian beliefs. Evolution and standard science taught.
profiles.price_notes: PDF downloads: individual subjects from about $24; full-grade bundles about $79 (kindergarten) to $162 (grade 4), as of Jul 2026; books sourced separately from the library or bookstores; seasonal sales discount 20-30%

profiles.name: BookShark
profiles.religious_notes: Markets itself as secular and faith neutral. Its own FAQ states the science and history programs teach neither evolution nor creationism, which is the classic neutral posture. Strict secular reviewers (SEA-adjacent) flag residual Christian-influenced book and history choices inherited from Sonlight.
profiles.price_notes: All-Subject Packages about $871 (Level B) to $915 (Level A) as of Jul 2026, with other levels in a similar band; packages run 20% below itemized retail (10% for high school); Reading with History cores alone cost less

profiles.name: Brave Writer
profiles.religious_notes: Content-neutral; a favorite in secular and Charlotte Mason circles, also used by religious families
profiles.price_notes: Year-long literature program (9 monthly handbooks) $129-179, Growing Brave Writers $79 one time, writing project programs $47-197 by stage, single handbooks $19.95; online classes $179-349 each push totals into the $$$-$$$$ range, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Build Your Library
profiles.religious_notes: Deliberately secular; Cathy Duffy notes the author purposely sources books without an underlying Christian point of view, and religious stories appear only as mythology alongside other cultures' myths.
profiles.price_notes: PDF lesson plans $29.95 (Level 0) to $59.95 (Levels 9-12) per level as of the publisher's posted price structure, checked Jul 2026; unit studies $7.95-12.95; books are extra ($300-600 if purchased, far less via library)

profiles.name: Christian Light Education (CLE)
profiles.religious_notes: Mennonite (Anabaptist) publisher; nonresistance, separation from politics, plain-dress illustrations, and rural values reflected in content
profiles.price_notes: LightUnits about $5.55 each, roughly $51-56 per subject-year plus teacher guides; a full 5-subject year lands around $300-500 by grade, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Classical Conversations
profiles.religious_notes: Explicitly Christian ('to know God and to make Him known'); Bible memory in cycles; directors and tutors operate within a Christian statement of purpose
profiles.price_notes: community tuition set locally: Foundations roughly $400-750, Essentials adds $385-800, Challenge $800-2,400+ per student per year, plus $100-700 in materials; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: CTCMath
profiles.price_notes: standard $257 single or $397 family per year; a perennial homeschool half-price offer lands families at about $148.50 to 198.50 per year for all grades and kids, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Curiosity Chronicles
profiles.religious_notes: Explicitly secular and inclusive; religions are covered as historical and cultural facts; marketed as the non-Eurocentric alternative
profiles.price_notes: full curriculum bundles about $73-95 per volume (digital vs print); both Early Modern volumes together $145-180; audiobook adds $10 to any bundle, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Dimensions Math
profiles.religious_notes: No religious content; broadly acceptable across secular and religious segments
profiles.price_notes: about $103 core or $169 full set per grade for PK-5, plus optional $85/yr video subscription, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Drive Thru History
profiles.religious_notes: On-location storytelling with archaeology and biblical context; roughly half the catalog is Bible history (Gospels, Acts, biblical archaeology)
profiles.price_notes: All-Access streaming $119.95 per year; individual courses $19.90-$89.95 lifetime; DVD sets about $20-90 at retail, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Easy Peasy All-in-One Homeschool
profiles.religious_notes: Overtly Christian throughout, Bible is a scheduled subject; no denominational affiliation stated
profiles.price_notes: Entirely free online (suggested donation); optional printed workbooks and offline course books sold separately, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Elemental Science (Classic Series)
profiles.religious_notes: Publisher's own framing: neither Christian nor secular, 'just science'. The guides avoid origins; the secular spine books contain evolutionary content; evolution and Big Bang pages are optional in middle grades and scheduled outright in high school. Cathy Duffy describes the presentation as secular; secular purists classify it as neutral.
profiles.price_notes: printed teacher guide and workbook combo about $35-48 per year; with required spine books about $67-99; bundles with experiment kit about $85-135; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Explode the Code
profiles.price_notes: About $10-18 per workbook at retail (2-4 books per year typical); Explode the Code Online about $65 per student per year, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Five in a Row
profiles.publisher: Five in a Row Publishing (Jane Claire Lambert)
profiles.religious_notes: The authors are Christians; the core Volumes 1-5 contain no religious content and are widely used by secular families. Bible content is sold as separate optional supplements; Before and More Before volumes include optional devotionals that can be skipped.
profiles.price_notes: Each teacher manual (Before, More Before, Volumes 1-8) is $49 in print or digital as of Jul 2026; the picture books are extra, mostly library-sourceable, or about $10-20 each purchased

profiles.name: Fix It! Grammar
profiles.religious_notes: Content-neutral story passages from an explicitly Christian-owned publisher
profiles.price_notes: $29 per level for a teacher/student combo, $19 each separately; six levels, one year each, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Gather Round Homeschool
profiles.religious_notes: Christ-centered throughout: Bible woven into units, family devotional closes lessons, conservative values; no secular edition
profiles.price_notes: digital units about $28-30, full-year digital bundles about $238 covering all children; printed books are per student ($238 one student, $359 two, Apr 2025 snapshot); Modular Math K-9 sold separately; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Generation Genius
profiles.religious_notes: Secular and NGSS-aligned; produced in partnership with the National Science Teaching Association.
profiles.price_notes: home plans widely cited at $95 per year for one subject and $145 for science plus math; the publisher's help page lists a $325 homeschool plan with a 50 percent co-op discount ($163), so quoted rates vary by channel and sale; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Global Village School
profiles.religious_notes: Secular with an explicit values identity: peace, social justice, diversity, and sustainability woven through the curriculum guides; welcomes LGBTQIA+ families and a wide range of worldviews.
profiles.price_notes: Enrollment tuition about $2,745-3,975 per year for K-8 and about $8,450 per year for high school, with semester options from about $1,705, per 2026 third-party profiles; curriculum-only purchase exists at lower cost; verify on the school's site before quoting

profiles.name: Handwriting Without Tears
profiles.price_notes: Student workbooks about $12-20 each (one per grade per child); teacher's guides about $25; optional manipulatives $5-35 per item, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Heart of Dakota
profiles.religious_notes: Protestant; providential history framing in some scheduled texts
profiles.price_notes: guides about $125-185; economy packages roughly $170-500 by level; a fully resourced high school year can exceed $1,500, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: History Quest
profiles.religious_notes: Explicitly secular: religious beliefs are presented as historical sources and perspectives, not factual accounts; from the publisher of REAL Science Odyssey
profiles.price_notes: chapter book $36.99, study guide $64.99, audiobook $33.99 direct; about $102 per year for the core pair, discounted at retailers, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Horizons Math
profiles.religious_notes: Protestant publisher; Bible verses and church-themed word problems woven in lightly, most lessons purely mathematical
profiles.price_notes: $120 list per grade boxed set (two workbooks plus teacher's guide), street about $85 to 120, manipulatives extra, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Institute for Excellence in Writing (Structure and Style)
profiles.religious_notes: Christian-owned company (Andrew Pudewa); the core Structure and Style courses are content-neutral, but some theme books (Bible Heroes) are explicitly Christian, and convention culture skews Christian
profiles.price_notes: Structure and Style for Students Year 1: Basic $169, Basic Plus $189, Premier $289 per level; theme-based writing lessons run cheaper; Fix It! Grammar $29 per level combo, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: IXL
profiles.price_notes: Single subject $9.95/mo or $79/yr; math + language arts combo $15.95/mo or $129/yr; core subjects $19.95/mo or $159/yr; extra children about $4/mo each, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Khan Academy
profiles.price_notes: Core platform and Khan Academy Kids fully free, no ads; Khanmigo AI tutor $4/mo or $44/yr (free for verified US teachers), as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Life of Fred
profiles.publisher: Polka Dot Publishing (author Stanley F. Schmidt)
profiles.religious_notes: Occasional light Christian references reported by reviewers; not a Bible-based program
profiles.price_notes: hardcovers roughly $16 to $39 each depending on level; most families use a few books per year, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Logic of English
profiles.price_notes: Foundations A bundle from about $88; Foundations plus reusable Core Materials about $227 for a first-time buyer; Essentials 1-7 with Core Materials about $222, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Master Books
profiles.religious_notes: Explicitly young-earth creationist; publishes Ken Ham and most Answers in Genesis material; apologetics woven through science and history
profiles.price_notes: Basic 4-Subject Sets about $151 (K) to $377 (grade 11) at publisher sale prices, list about $189-471, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Math Mammoth (Light Blue series)
profiles.religious_notes: Curriculum content is secular and Common Core aligned; the author is openly Christian but keeps the material neutral
profiles.price_notes: $39.50 per grade as a digital download, discounted multi-grade bundles, printed worktexts extra, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Math-U-See
profiles.religious_notes: No religious content in the math; founder Steve Demme also runs a Christian family ministry, so the brand reads Christian-friendly
profiles.price_notes: about $130 to $190 per level Universal Set, $65 to $122 Level Up sets, one-time $80-plus Integer Block Kit, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Math with Confidence
profiles.price_notes: about $50 to $105 per grade in print at list (instructor guide plus one or two workbooks), commonly discounted below $75, PDFs less, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Memoria Press Classical Core Curriculum
profiles.religious_notes: Broadly Christian (Christian Studies strand, scripture memory); not denominationally narrow; content is classical-humanist plus Christian rather than worldview-saturated
profiles.price_notes: complete grade packages roughly $250-350 (Jr K), $400-500 (grades 1-3), $500-700 (grades 4-8), $600-900 (high school); optional Memoria Academy classes $400-700 per course; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Miacademy
profiles.religious_notes: Core content avoids religious material; optional Biblical Studies electives exist; secular families flag thin evolution coverage in K-8 science
profiles.price_notes: $48/mo, $480/yr, or $1,120 lifetime per child; family lifetime $2,520 for up to 4 kids; first month $1.99; MiaPrep (7-12) $54/mo; accredited MiaPrep Online High School about $394/mo, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Miquon Math
profiles.publisher: Miquon Math Materials (distributed via Rainbow Resource)
profiles.price_notes: about $16.95 per lab workbook (two per grade), plus Cuisenaire rods and the Lab Sheet Annotations guide, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Moving Beyond the Page
profiles.publisher: Moving Beyond the Page (Kim and Keith Howe)
profiles.religious_notes: Fully secular; science teaches evolution and an old earth and universe explicitly.
profiles.price_notes: Full-year packages about $553 (age 5-7, three subjects) to $1,100 (age 12-14, three subjects) as of Jul 2026, with all-subject young-age packages around $809-953; single subjects and individual units cost far less; additional students need a consumables package (about $577 at age 12-14)

profiles.name: Mr. D Math
profiles.religious_notes: Math-only neutrality; no religious content either way
profiles.price_notes: Self-paced $247 per course (15-month access); live class $247 curriculum + $290 live instruction ($537 total, or $34/mo x 10 for the live portion); charter pricing slightly lower, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: My Father's World
profiles.religious_notes: Protestant with a pronounced missions emphasis; founders came from Bible-translation missionary work
profiles.price_notes: core packages roughly $310-600 (Exploring Countries and Cultures $538 sale, $598 list); math and language arts sold separately, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: The Mystery of History
profiles.religious_notes: Evangelical Protestant, creationist; Bible events taught as literal history on one world timeline using Ussher's chronology; author publishes a statement of faith
profiles.price_notes: $99.95 list per volume for reader plus digital companion guide, on sale $79.95 direct; best-seller bundle with audiobook and atlases $157, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Mystery Science
profiles.religious_notes: Fully secular and NGSS-aligned; teaches natural selection, the fossil record, and the geologic age of the earth, so strict young-earth families rule it out on contact.
profiles.price_notes: $199 per year homeschool science membership, $259 bundled with Mystery Writing, membership runs through June 30, 2027; discounted sales in April and August; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Night Zookeeper
profiles.price_notes: $12.99/mo or $119.99/yr list, with near-permanent 50% promos bringing annual to about $59.99-89.99; multi-child discounts; 7-day trial, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Noeo Science
profiles.religious_notes: Christian company whose lessons contain no explicit religious instruction and use secular trade books; marketed to and used by both Christian and secular-leaning families. Reviewers variously label it secular or neutral.
profiles.price_notes: full-year packages (instructor guide, lab manual, book set, experiment kits) about $189-295 depending on course; instructor guide alone about $46; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Notgrass History
profiles.religious_notes: Protestant, devotional; high school courses fold in a full Bible credit; Cathy Duffy notes a conservative, limited-government philosophy in the texts
profiles.price_notes: curriculum packages $95-125 per course; complete bundles with literature $221-275, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Oak Meadow
profiles.religious_notes: Explicitly secular; no religious instruction. The K-3 methodology carries a soft Waldorf/Steiner spiritual undercurrent (child as a complete being, rhythm, reverence for nature) that Cathy Duffy labels New Age; it shapes method more than content.
profiles.price_notes: Independent-use print packages about $449 (K) to $685-$775 (grades 1-4) and $850-$1,250 in materials for grades 5-8, as of Jul 2026; digital subscriptions cost less (K $315). Enrolling in the accredited distance school adds tuition: $2,870 (K-4) or $3,860 (5-8) per year, $2,150 per high school course.

profiles.name: Outschool
profiles.religious_notes: Secular platform; class content varies by independent teacher
profiles.price_notes: A la carte or credit membership: 80 credits/$40/mo up to 1,285 credits/$600/mo, credit worth 50 cents; small-group classes typically $5-36/session, 1:1 tutoring $24-58/session, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: The Peaceful Press
profiles.religious_notes: Gently Christian: Bible verses in copywork and hymns woven through; lighter worldview intensity than most Christian curricula
profiles.price_notes: digital guides $49 each (Nourishing Nature kindergarten $59), each covering 26-30 weeks for the family; math and phonics purchased separately; books extra; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Power Homeschool (Acellus)
profiles.publisher: Acellus Corporation / International Academy of Science
profiles.religious_notes: Marketed secular; the 2020 Hawaii DOE content review found religious content presenting Christian views as fact in some lessons, since reportedly removed
profiles.price_notes: $99/mo per student ($79/mo with scholarship rate), roughly tripled from about $31/mo in mid-2025; accredited Acellus Academy enrollment starts around $249/mo, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Prodigy
profiles.price_notes: Core math game free; memberships $9.95-19.95/mo or $58.95-118.95/yr unlock cosmetic and game perks, not extra instruction; Prodigy English sold separately, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Real Science-4-Kids
profiles.religious_notes: Publisher self-describes as a secular program with a worldview-neutral stance: no religious content, but evolution and origins are deliberately deferred out of K-8. Secular purists dispute the neutral label; young-earth families find it safely silent. The canonical example of the neutral middle segment.
profiles.price_notes: Science Series hardcover textbook $92; print trio (textbook, student pages, teacher pages) $184-215 per year; digital teaching dashboard $169 for 18 months; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: RightStart Mathematics
profiles.price_notes: about $97.50 per level book bundle plus a one-time RS2 Math Set around $220, so about $300 to $316 in year one, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Rod and Staff
profiles.religious_notes: Conservative Mennonite; nonresistance and separation from politics reflected in texts; plain-dress rural illustrations
profiles.price_notes: individual workbooks from about $4-20; a full grade runs roughly $80-250 new, less with reused hardbacks, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: The Sassafras Science Adventures
profiles.religious_notes: Same neutral posture as Elemental Science's Classic Series; commonly recommended in secular homeschool circles as a story-based option.
profiles.price_notes: novels about $15-16, SCIDAT logbooks about $11-12, guides and bundles more; a typical print year (two semester volumes with logbooks and guides) runs about $90-130, while an ebook-and-lapbook path can run about $25 per volume; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Saxon Math
profiles.religious_notes: No religious content; widely used by both Christian and secular families
profiles.price_notes: about $118 to $160 street for a homeschool kit per level, list up to $323, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Sequential Spelling
profiles.price_notes: About $30-45 per level for teacher's guide plus consumable student response book; seven levels, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Simply Charlotte Mason
profiles.religious_notes: Explicitly Biblical: the history rotation interweaves Bible history with world history; scripture memory and hymn study are core strands
profiles.price_notes: subject guides $30-80 each, full-year bundles roughly $200-300 plus $50-150 in living books; a three-child family reports $250-450 total per year; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Simply Good and Beautiful Math
profiles.religious_notes: LDS-founded publisher; the math line has very minimal Christian content (occasional KJV verses, character-virtue stories), much lighter than the company's language arts
profiles.price_notes: all course PDFs free; printed course sets about $50 to $80 per level and Math Boxes $28.99, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Sonlight
profiles.religious_notes: Evangelical with a strong global missions emphasis; uses non-Christian and secular books deliberately with discussion notes; lighter worldview integration than Abeka or BJU
profiles.price_notes: All-Subjects Packages list about $1,056-1,575 with a standard 20% discount bringing most to about $845-1,260, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: The Story of the World
profiles.religious_notes: Author is Christian; Bible narratives (Abraham, Moses, Jesus) get story-length retellings alongside other traditions, so both secular and Christian families flag the balance
profiles.price_notes: about $50-75 per volume-year for text plus activity book and tests; audiobook adds $22-45, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Tapestry of Grace
profiles.religious_notes: Reformed Protestant viewpoint woven through history and worldview strands; Cathy Duffy notes it treats Orthodox and Catholic views respectfully in church history
profiles.price_notes: one plan covers the whole family: digital year-plan snapshots range roughly $120-250 (units from about $45-85), plus books ($500-700 realistic with older students; publisher's everything-new ceiling estimate $2,000); as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Teach Your Child to Read in 100 Easy Lessons
profiles.publisher: Simon and Schuster (authors Engelmann, Haddox, Bruner)
profiles.price_notes: One trade paperback, about $16-25 retail, non-consumable, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: TPT (Teachers Pay Teachers)
profiles.religious_notes: Marketplace carries everything from secular classroom to Bible units; no worldview vetting
profiles.price_notes: typical single resources $3-10, bundles $16-36 after steep anchor discounts, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Teaching Textbooks
profiles.religious_notes: No religious content; Christian-owned company, marketed heavily in Christian homeschool circles and used across both markets
profiles.price_notes: $48.95 to $83.95 per level per year by grade band, family plan $216.95 per year for 4 to 8 children, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: The Good and the Beautiful
profiles.publisher: The Good and the Beautiful, LLC
profiles.religious_notes: LDS founder, broadly Christian nondenominational content; no denominational doctrine taught; a subset of evangelical families object on principle
profiles.price_notes: language arts and math K-8 are free full-course PDFs; printed course sets about $49-126 per level, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: The Good and the Beautiful Language Arts
profiles.publisher: The Good and the Beautiful (Jenny Phillips)
profiles.religious_notes: LDS founder, deliberately broad non-denominational Christian content; God and character themes are woven through lessons, no doctrine. Some evangelical families object to the LDS connection, some secular families use it anyway for the price and look
profiles.price_notes: Levels K-8 are free full-course PDF downloads; printed course sets about $49-90 per level, High School 1-3 sets $118-126, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: The Good and the Beautiful science units
profiles.religious_notes: General Christian content (God as creator, gratitude, basic Bible principles) from an LDS-founded publisher; deliberately neutral on the age of the earth and silent on evolution so both young-earth and old-earth Christians can use it. See the brand-level worldview discussion in ../all-in-one/the-good-and-the-beautiful.md.
profiles.price_notes: course book $19.99 (one per family) plus student journal $9.99 per child per unit; a typical 3-5 unit year runs about $90-150 for the first student and $30-50 per additional student; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Timberdoodle
profiles.religious_notes: A curator, not an author: family-owned by Christians, sells parallel Classic kits (some faith-based components, Protestant orientation, usually in history or science) and Nonreligious kits (charter-school-friendly secular alternatives) at every grade. The worldview lives in individual components, which are swappable.
profiles.price_notes: Complete kits typically about $500-1,500 depending on grade and tier, per 2026 reviews; verified example: 2026 twelfth-grade kit $1,959 (Elite tier shown) with additional-student kit $1,154.86, as of Jul 2026; Basic tiers and individual products cost much less

profiles.name: Time4Learning
profiles.religious_notes: Fully secular, standards-aligned; evolution and standard science taught
profiles.price_notes: $39.95/mo per student, all grades; annual plan about 30% off (roughly $336/yr); additional students discounted; extra middle/high courses $5/mo each, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Torchlight
profiles.religious_notes: Distinctively secular with stated Humanist underpinnings; religion is studied academically as culture and myth, never posited as fact; guides flag incidental religious mentions in scheduled books so parents can handle them their own way. Teaches climate change and evolution-consistent science.
profiles.price_notes: PDF levels roughly $30-100, rising with level, as of Jul 2026; books and project supplies are extra and mostly library-sourceable; recommended science (Real Science Odyssey, Be Naturally Curious) and reading (Logic of English) are separate purchases; sales of 10-15% each June and late November

profiles.name: TruthQuest History
profiles.religious_notes: Strongly providential: the site tagline is seeking God's truth embedded in the flow of history; commentary intensity exceeds most Christian programs even though the book lists range widely
profiles.price_notes: guides $24.95-$39.95 print, $19.95-$29.95 PDF; living books sourced separately, often from the library, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Veritas Press
profiles.religious_notes: Reformed-leaning classical Christian; Bible history integrated with world history from grade 2; Omnibus reads the Great Books 'through a biblical lens'
profiles.price_notes: self-paced courses $349 list (frequent $100-off sales) plus $85-190 kits per course; You Teach history kits and Omnibus texts less; VSA live classes cost more per course; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: The Well-Trained Mind ecosystem
profiles.publisher: W. W. Norton (book); Well-Trained Mind Press (curricula)
profiles.religious_notes: Susan Wise Bauer is Christian but writes inclusively; the guide and Story of the World are used without modification by both secular and Christian families, and recommendations span both
profiles.price_notes: the guide itself is a $20-40 book (Essential Edition adds a subscription recommendations portal); a self-assembled WTM-style year typically lands around $200-500 per child depending on chosen components; as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Well-Trained Mind Press language arts (First Language Lessons + Writing With Ease/Skill)
profiles.religious_notes: Secular content from a press whose audience spans secular and Christian classical families
profiles.price_notes: FLL Level 1 about $19 list; WWE revised complete workbooks about $24-39 by retailer; a grammar plus writing year in the elementary grades runs roughly $40-70, as of Jul 2026

profiles.name: Wildwood Curriculum
profiles.religious_notes: Explicitly secular and inclusive Charlotte Mason; modern, diverse book choices replacing the religious and colonial-era content of traditional CM booklists.
profiles.price_notes: Curriculum guides and booklists are entirely free on the website as of Jul 2026; families buy or borrow the living books themselves

profiles.name: WriteShop
profiles.religious_notes: Cathy Duffy files it secular but Christian friendly
profiles.price_notes: Primary sets from about $34-39 per level; Junior sets from about $84.50; WriteShop I/II bundles roughly $130-140, as of Jul 2026
